models.authors: BSST + RAFT of huicongzhang/BSSTNet (ModelBSST.get_bi_flows + test_by_patch as runs/baselines/bsstnet/run_bsst.py runs them: 256 px patches, 64 px overlap, fp16 autocast), BSST_gopro.pth + raft-things.pth
models.dbis: dbis-BSSTNet (dbis/bsst.py, patch_batch=1, dbis-BSSTNet.safetensors): one patch per BSST call as the authors
models.dbisf: dbisf-BSSTNet (dbis/bsst.py, patch_batch=14, stage_batch=4, nan_fallback; dbisf-BSSTNet.wpk: weights rounded per output channel to std / 48, tier qc of dbis/wpack.py)

rule: dbisf: mean PSNR at most 0.05 dB below the authors' code on every test set (25.11)

exactness.dbis: patch_batch=1 is bit-identical to the authors' runner (flows, patch calls, whole windows) on GOPR0384_11_00 and GOPR0862_11_00 frames 0..47, fp16 autocast and fp32
exactness.keys: A = authors, O = dbis/bsst.py; 16 = fp16 autocast, 32 = fp32; _N = patches per BSST call

quality.run: GoPro weights on the four video test sets, the leaderboard's windows (48 frames, 4 overlap, every frame written), 8-bit outputs, PSNR against the sharp frame; non-finite values become 0 as in the protocol

black_tiles.note: the authors' code writes NaN into some 256 px patches on REDS and BSD (black tiles after the 8-bit conversion): an fp16 overflow, and a blow-up of the recurrent backward propagation whose LayerNorm overflows in float32 too. dbisf redoes a patch that is not finite in float32 without autocast and keeps the blurry input where it is still not finite
black_tiles.leaderboard_bsd: the leaderboard's BSD row is the authors' code in fp32 (23.7607), REDS and the others fp16

latency_ms.harness: eval/adapters/bench_unified.py over the runs/pareto_bench Offline stepper, as the leaderboard: one A100, 1280x720, batch 1, a 48-frame window per output frame (window position 2 emitted), the first 250 GoPro test frames; slower than 0.5 s per step: 5 warm-up steps, 5 to 9 timed steps, median. Each version in its fastest valid mode (the leaderboard's rule), the three on the same node and GPU (cn10, 25.11).

mode_used.authors: b: fp16 autocast + torch.compile(max-autotune-no-cudagraphs), 18.5 min of compilation
mode_used.dbis: c: fp16 eager (b fails: torch.compile AssertionError 'incorrect out shape after application of ViewMeta sequence')
mode_used.dbisf: c: fp16 eager (b: torch.compile did not finish within the harness's 30 min)

b.label: fp16 autocast + compile max-autotune-no-cudagraphs
b.error: AssertionError: incorrect out shape after application of ViewMeta sequence: (1, 960, 64, 64) (actual) vs (1, 192, 64, 64) (expected)

validity.reference: fp32 eager of the leaderboard run (01.11), mean PSNR of the first 20 outputs of the first GoPro sequence
validity.rule: a mode is valid within 0.05 dB of it; every timed mode above is

load_s.run: a fresh Python process, from CUDA ready to BSST and RAFT with their weights on the GPU; median of 5 (authors: run_bsst.make_runner, which builds both networks and reads both checkpoints)

dropped.unused_modules: feat_extract, decoder_level1_2, decoder_level2, decoder_level2_1, decoder_level2_2, conv_before_upsampler, conv_before_input, upsampler, conv_last (never called by BSST.forward; 8,271,043 values)
dropped.index_buffers: relative_position_index (4), valid_ind_rolled (4), mask_padding (4): checked equal to the rebuilt ones in fold(), rebuilt at run time
dropped.raft_norm3: cnet layer2.0/layer3.0 norm3 (same module as downsample.1, checked equal)

patch_batch.what: one GoPro window, 48 frames 1280x720, dbisf-BSSTNet fp16 eager, stage_batch 4
patch_batch.use: dbis.load('dbisf-BSSTNet') then net(x, patch_batch=N) or net.patch_batch = N: a smaller batch for a card with less memory; patch_batch changes only float rounding

site.title: BSSTNet, GoPro weights

about.dbis: one patch per call as the authors; runs eager (torch.compile fails on it)
about.dbisf: 14 patches per call, weights rounded per channel, failed patches redone. It takes 36 GiB of GPU memory (9.4 GiB for the authors' code); net(x, patch_batch=3) fits a 24 GB card at 18.6 s per frame.

site.time_mode: a 48-frame window for every output frame as in the leaderboard, each version in its fastest mode that runs (the authors' code fp16 with torch.compile, ours fp16 eager)
site.note: One A100, 1280×720, a 48-frame window per output frame as in the leaderboard; each version in its fastest mode that runs (the authors' code fp16 with torch.compile, ours fp16 eager); PSNR on all 1,111 GoPro test frames.
site.extra_note: On REDS and BSD the authors' code turns some patches black (466 and 376 frames). dbisf redoes them in float32 and keeps the input where that fails too: REDS 27.74 dB instead of 24.39, BSD 24.58 instead of 22.77. On the other frames it is within 0.05 dB of the authors.
